judgment.rationale: The maintained accessibility property has exact unused and binding sites.
evidence: List and grid templates bind automation names to Title instead.
No duplicate or existing fix covers this symbol.

fix_assessment.rationale: No existing fix attempt binds AccessibleName to the focusable list/grid containers.

proposed_fixes.title: Use AccessibleName for CmdPal result items
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The view model computes AccessibleName but templates and focusable containers expose Title or content-derived names to UI Automation.
plan: Bind list and grid item templates or containers to AccessibleName.
Cover virtualization and property updates with unit and UI Automation tests.
verification: Accessibility tooling reports the combined title/subtitle for focused list and grid results.

confidence.rationale: Search identified the sole property definition and all template binding sites.

issue_context.summary: CmdPal spends effort maintaining an accessible result name but does not expose it on the focusable result controls.
known_information: AccessibleName is built from Title and Subtitle.
The report was filed against a development build.
List and grid views are the affected result surfaces.
inferences: The container automation peer, not only inner text, should receive the binding.
Empty subtitles should not create a trailing comma.
issue_context.analysis: Binding the existing property preserves the intended accessibility design and makes updates flow through the existing property notification path.
initial_investigation: Confirmed no competing fix or duplicate.
Fork mirror Issue 639 contains the detailed design and adversary approval.

design.root_cause: ListItemViewModel.AccessibleName is maintained but ListItemsView templates set AutomationProperties.Name from Title, leaving the combined accessible string unused.
evidence: [Observed] AccessibleName is updated on title/subtitle changes.
[Observed] List and grid templates use Title for automation naming.
[Inferred] Recycled containers need explicit binding/clearing to avoid stale names.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: Title and Subtitle are concatenated with a separator even when one is empty.
implementation_steps.change: Join only non-empty parts and notify once.
edge_cases: Null and whitespace values should produce an empty or single-part name.
Preserve notification behavior for virtualization and refresh.

implementation_steps.current_behavior: AutomationProperties.Name is bound to Title or inferred from content.
implementation_steps.change: Bind the accessible name on every result template and, if needed, the focusable recycled container.
implementation_steps.code_block: - AutomationProperties.Name="{x:Bind Title, Mode=OneWay}"\n+ AutomationProperties.Name="{x:Bind AccessibleName, Mode=OneWay}"
edge_cases: Use item source explicitly when handling recycled containers.
Keep tooltips and visual title text unchanged.
tests: UI Automation finds combined names after virtualization and after result refresh.

verify: Build CmdPal view-model and UI tests with the existing build scripts.
Use Accessibility Insights or UIA Verify on list, small grid, medium grid, and gallery results and confirm the focused item exposes Title, Subtitle.
risks: Changing container names can affect automation clients; this is the intended contract and is limited to result items.
Template-only binding may not cover every automation peer, so container binding should be used where required.
alternatives: Removing AccessibleName wastes existing accessibility work.
Binding only inner text may leave the focusable peer unchanged.
